scene: The brass key opens gate locks, revealing three waiting transport routes.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of the station platform. On the far left stands a grated service elevator with an open door. In the centre, the curly-haired boy in a denim jacket holds a brass key. To his right sits a heavy steel freight lift platform, and on the far right waits a lighted night tram.
shown: a grated iron service elevator cage on the far left with open doors
a heavy steel freight lift platform with a chain control on the right
a glowing yellow night tram parked along tracks on the far right
